learner_assumption: Treat Ninereeds as ungrounded random parameters; prior encoder exposure is bonus evidence only.
scope: Early concrete lexical sets whose size is a positive multiple of four.
set_protocol: Prefer about 16 tested things when coherent; use fewer or more by documented judgment; every set contains exactly four tested things.
visual_rule: The visual must preserve every semantic operand. Crop only when it improves reference resolution and never when it destroys a relation, social ritual, or comparison.
story_rule: Use a coherent grounding event with immutable reviewed referents; story questions test demonstrated story facts and never rely on captions still being visible.
intervention_rule: PRESENT_AGAIN, TRAIN_MORE, and TRAIN_LONGER use only frozen material, have explicit release and stop rules, and cannot turn modeled or repeated output into mastery evidence.
alarm_rule: ALARM is always available, freezes all learner-facing output immediately, and preserves the complete log.
qualification_rule: Static blind Sol approval unlocks rehearsal; blind rehearsal analysis plus human PDF approval qualifies the pattern for later autonomous reuse.
